question: Can the fresh-confirmed cached responses of MLP12/13/15/16/17 be compiled into exact checkpoint-weight bilinear tensors whose propagated mode effects equal their causal response effects?

frozen_design.population: The same 24 fresh temporal-v13 confirmation rows plus the same 30 is/was-v12 replay rows; evidence scope remains fresh temporal and provisional is/was.
frozen_design.local_program: For each ungated bilinear MLP and paired normalized inputs x0,x1, compile Down[(Left1-Left0)*Right0 + Left0*(Right1-Right0) + (Left1-Left0)*(Right1-Right0)]. Down bias cancels exactly.
frozen_design.mode_program: Contract each MLP's exact CP tensor with the two gauge-safe physical final reader covectors pulled back by the exact product of later residual lambda0 gains.
frozen_design.causal_check: Compare weight-predicted query mode deltas with selected-program minus leave-one-site-out final-state deltas; also execute all 15 individual factor-response interventions.
frozen_design.dependency_boundary: The program compiles literal checkpoint weights and exact paired MLP inputs. It does not yet compile how upstream modules generate those activation-conditioned inputs.

predictions.pred_a_authority_architecture_gauge_repl: Hashes, ungated bilinear architecture, physical-reader identity, self/live replay, attention reconstruction, finiteness, and exact price pass.
predictions.pred_b_all_five_local_weight_expansions_: For every site the three checkpoint-weight factors sum to live-minus-base MLP output with max absolute error <=0.001 and relative squared error <=1e-8.
predictions.pred_c_weight_propagated_modes_equal_cau: For every site, both mode vectors predicted from the local output and later residual gains match selected-minus-site causal final-state modes with max absolute error <=0.001 and relative squared error <=1e-6.
predictions.pred_d_all_five_weight_tensors_have_caus: Each site's exact tensor-induced mode2 effect has signed projection >=0.02 on both tasks relative to the full writer response.
predictions.pred_e_complete_zero_fit_literal_factor_: All five CP tensor manifests and all 15 left-change/right-change/bilinear-interaction intervention arms are present with no fit or model update.

decision: All gates yield literal_bilinear_weight_program and license a separate upstream input-generation incidence atlas. Failure of local closure is invalid; failure of propagated equality rejects the cached-to-weight compilation; failure of mode support keeps only the supported site tensors.
